caption: The drawing shows a single, central object: a finely detailed pewter or silver tankard rendered in shades of grey pencil on a cream-colored background. The tankard has a gracefully curved body with a slightly flared lip and a round, broad base, both featuring a decorative border of repeating scroll or leaf motifs. The ornate handle, attached to one side, has a scrolling shape and is adorned with intricate patterns, including leaf-like embellishments along its curve. The composition is bordered by a simple rectangular frame, and there are two inset drawings: the upper left contains a monogram of intertwined letters, "H B" or "H G," drawn in a decorative script, and the lower right features a small technical side-view sketch of the tankard with annotated measurements for height and width. The entire drawing is executed in monochrome with delicate shading, giving the tankard a metallic appearance.
title: Silver Mug
